resources.string: Locking screen rotation is now supported. The user orientation screen has been removed since locking screen rotation lets you do the same thing. See the instructions in the main screen for details.
Use this app to control screen rotation
Rotation control by this app will be disabled. (You can re-enable it in this app\'s settings screen.) Disable and uninstall this app?

This application needs an accelerometer to run, but it didn\'t find one in this device. If the device does have one, try using the device\'s \"Auto-rotate screen\" option. If that doesn\'t work, the accelerometer might be broken.
Another application has changed the screen orientation.
Failed to write the value \'%1$s\' for system setting \'%2$s\'.
Welcome to %1$s! This replaces your device\'s screen rotation, so don\'t try to control this app with the device\'s screen rotation settings.

There are two modes: Auto-Rotate and Locked. To see which one you\'re using, look at the notification in the notification drawer. In Locked mode, the notification will show the locked screen orientation, such as \"%1$s\".
To change mode, just touch the notification. You can also make a home screen shortcut %1$sto do this.
In Locked mode, rotating your device won\'t change the screen orientation.

Auto-Rotate mode works the same way as your device\'s screen rotation, except the screen will face you instead of always facing up. For example, if the app thinks you\'re sideways, the screen will rotate to face sideways.
Your orientation (whether you\'re lying down or upright) is also tracked. This is also shown in the notification.

To change your orientation, use Locked mode. In this mode, rotating your device will change whether this app thinks you\'re lying down or upright. It thinks you\'re facing the same direction as the screen. For example, if the screen is facing sideways, this app will think you\'re sideways.
Some of the apps on your device might control the screen orientation themselves, so this app might not work with them. When this happens, the notification will show \"%1$s\".
To uninstall this, use the menu item on this app\'s main screen so the screen orientation isn\'t left in the wrong state.
If you get stuck with the screen facing the wrong way:\n1. Turn Auto-Rotate off.\n2. Rotate your device until the screen is facing the right way.
